purpose: The animal's equivalent of ORGAN_GREEN_LEDGER.json. One record per learning faculty, judged against LC1..LC12 by scripts/verify_learning_conditions.py. Verdicts are COMPUTED, never written here by hand: this file declares the inputs (owner, entrypoints, callers, stores, tests, evidence) and the verifier decides. A faculty is green only when every condition passes or is declared N/A-BY-DESIGN with a referent.
honesty_note: The first honest run of this ledger is expected to be mostly yellow. A ledger that goes green on the day it is written is not measuring anything.

faculties.name: Reflection (failure -> lesson)
known_blockers: Gate decisions (BLOCKED / REQUIRE_APPROVAL) are excluded from reflection by verifier.py _GATE_STATUSES, but the second entry point (tool_loop_helpers.reflect -> on_failure) has not been proven to carry the same guard.

na_by_design.LC4: Reflection keeps no append-only journal of its own; lessons are rows in mistake_pool, which is a mutable store by design (occurrence_count, verification_status). Referent: aios/memory/mistake.py::MistakeMemory

faculties.name: Lesson transfer (recall -> confirm -> promote)
known_blockers: All 87 lessons in the live pool carry an empty failed_command, so none can ever be confirmed by a later success. The promotion path is not broken; it has nothing promotable to act on. Retirement is Stage 5.

na_by_design.LC4: No journal of its own; promotion mutates the lesson row in place. Referent: aios/memory/mistake.py::MistakeMemory.promote

live_evidence.description: Three per-tier arcs reached `verified` from organic data on 2026-09-21: build_auto_verify_command via ollama.qwen2.5-coder-7b (3S/0F), next_step_after_blocked_read and next_step_after_noop via qwen.qwen3-coder-30b-a3b (3S/0F each). Repo-wide verified skills 3 -> 6. Produced by three runs of tools/reverse_engineer_gagos.py against a git worktree of this repository at a pinned sha, graded by the mutation negative control. NOT a claim about any other codebase, and NOT evidence that the resulting skills replay.

na_by_design.LC4: Skill state is a mutable counter row, not a journal. The append-only record of the attempts that produced it is the self-corpus trail. Referent: .aios/audit/reverse-engineering-runs.jsonl

faculties.name: Reflex compilation (skill -> playbook)
known_blockers: A decompiled playbook bars its skill from ever recompiling: the compile query excludes status IN ('compiled','decompiled') and no code path ever clears 'decompiled'. The module docstring claims recovery is possible once the skill re-earns verification; it is not. One live skill is in this state. Fix is Stage 5.

faculties.name: Reflex replay (a turn served with no LLM call)
known_blockers: 2 replays have ever been served without an LLM. There is no dated artifact proving a replay served a real turn on organic data, which is the single claim that would show the loop pays for itself. Producing it is Stage 3 mission 4.

faculties.name: Curriculum progression (levels -> mastered)
known_blockers: CurriculumMiner has zero references from the live turn path, so proposals are only generated when something calls it explicitly. Mastery itself is reachable (2 of 2 levels mastered).

faculties.name: Organic acquisition (self-corpus, contained)

durable_store.writes_via: git worktree at a pinned sha

mutation_probe.claim: The agent's new test must FAIL when the target function's body is replaced by `raise NotImplementedError`, else `assert True` would score as understanding.

known_blockers: The evidence trail lives under .aios/audit/, which is gitignored, so no third party can read it. A tracked trend summary is Stage 4.

live_evidence.description: Three full runs on 2026-09-21 against a worktree of this repository at a pinned sha, with AIOS_SCOPE_ROOTS replaced by the worktree and the live tree fingerprinted before and after. 4 of 4 targets earned per run; the positive control (grader earns on a known-correct pin test) passed before any model was asked. The live working tree was byte-identical afterwards.

na_by_design.LC2: L7 is an acquisition harness, not a turn-path faculty: it exists to FEED the loop from outside a chat turn, so reachability from generate_pipeline.py is not the right question for it. Referent: tools/reverse_engineer_gagos.py::main
na_by_design.LC3: Its durability requirement is the opposite of the others': the worktree is deliberately thrown away after every run, and what must survive is the trail (LC4) and the skill rows it wrote (L3/LC3). Referent: tools/self_corpus.py::teardown

durable_store.writes_via: pure functions; no state of its own

mutation_probe.claim: A pytest run that produced no output at all is refused rather than scored, in BOTH directions: it cannot become a model's failure, and it cannot satisfy the mutated negative control.

na_by_design.LC3: Stateless by design: derive_strength and the floor helpers are pure functions. Durability is the property of whatever records their verdict. Referent: aios/core/verification_strength.py::derive_strength
na_by_design.LC4: No journal: a classifier that writes nothing has nothing to journal. Its verdicts are recorded by L3 and by the self-corpus trail. Referent: aios/memory/skills.py::SkillMemory.record_attempt
